name: lesionlens
description: Local matched LiTS CT review workspace with measured GT metadata

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:python
scripts.test:python: uv run --with nibabel --with pillow --with scipy python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.serve: uv run --with nibabel --with scipy --with pillow python scripts/serve_integrated.py
scripts.test:md:python: uv run --with nibabel --with scipy --with pillow python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*evidence.py"
